page.layout: One printed title page: an engraved frontispiece (allegorical figures, globe, scales, sword) in the upper part; below it, within a cartouche, the title lines; at the foot the imprint line. No running text.
page.notes: The upper part of the page is an engraving (allegorical female figure with sword and scales, a seated figure with a globe, a crowned figure at right) and has no text. The imprint date is printed "Aº 1655" with the old-style numeral, rendered here as Anno 1655. Title lines in the cartouche are set in small capitals and the first line in black letter-like type; transcribed as printed. A small mark (a stroke/tilde) lies below the imprint at lower left; it is not text.
